headline: Banks and FIIs lifted Nifty, *breadth lagged behind*
subline: Bank Nifty gained 1.13% while the wider NSE tape split.
hero_text: Nifty closed at 25,387.40, up 0.38%. Banks led, but 1,404 stocks fell against 1,318 that rose.

why.title: Nifty closed near 25,400
why.desc: Expiry day ended just under the 25,400 max pain strike.

why.title: Lenders did the heavy lifting
why.desc: Nifty Bank rose 1.13%. Axis Bank gained 1.98% among the Nifty names.

why.title: Overseas screens stayed red
why.desc: The S&P 500 fell 0.56% and the DAX fell 1.49%, yet India held up.

why.title: FII cash outweighed DIIs
why.desc: FIIs added Rs 4,195.38 Cr in cash while DIIs added Rs 196.93 Cr.

sector_reasons.PSU Bank: State lenders led the whole board
sector_reasons.Realty: Firm bonds helped rate sensitive names
sector_reasons.Bank: Axis Bank's 1.98% gain led the lenders
sector_reasons.Energy: ONGC and Coal India both lost over 1.5%
sector_reasons.Consumer Durables: Lagged as money rotated to banks

bonus_text: 1,318 stocks rose and 1,404 fell on NSE. Inside the Nifty 50, 27 rose and 23 fell.
movers_note_gainers: Adani Enterprises led at 3.24%. Eicher Motors added 3.01%.
movers_note_losers: HCLTech fell most at 2.09%. Power Grid, HDFC Life, ONGC and Coal India trailed.
watch_text: FOMC minutes drop at 04:30 IST on Wednesday. Bank Nifty max pain sits at 60,000 against a 62,273 close.
lessons: Banks and rate sensitives led while IT, energy and FMCG slipped. One cluster set the tone.
Participation narrowed. Decliners outnumbered advancers even as the Nifty 50 split 27 to 23.
Global weakness did not travel. US and European screens fell while Indian banks rose.
Cash and futures pointed apart. FIIs bought cash but sold Rs 1,392 Cr of index futures.
alert_text: FOMC meeting minutes release at 04:30 IST on Wednesday, before the Indian open.
cta_headline: A bank led day. *Reopen the chart Wednesday*.
cta_sub: Wednesday 18 November opens after the FOMC minutes at 04:30 IST.
next_text: Wednesday 18 November opens after FOMC minutes at 04:30 IST. UK CPI prints at 16:30 IST.
caption_a:
Nifty rose 0.38% to 25,387.40, yet more NSE stocks fell (1,404) than rose (1,318).
Bank Nifty gained 1.13%. FIIs bought Rs 4,195.38 Cr in cash.
Watch: FOMC minutes land at 04:30 IST on Wednesday.
